other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
Applicant must not have applied for the internship earlier in the current financial year.
Applicant must be a student pursuing graduation or post‑graduation studies.
Internship is only open for candidates in the Information Technology (IT) domain.
The intern must provide their own laptop.
benefits_summary: Interns receive a completion certificate and workspace with internet access, but no financial remuneration.
